items.name: The Metropolitan Museum of Art (Fifth Avenue)
items.neighborhood: Upper East Side (1000 Fifth Ave at 82nd St)
items.exceptions: Closed Wednesday, Thanksgiving, Dec 25, Jan 1, and first Monday in May. Fri–Sat Date Night runs 17:00–21:00 with live music. Pay-what-you-wish applies only to NY State residents & NY/NJ/CT students.

items.name: The Museum of Modern Art (MoMA)
items.exceptions: Closed Thanksgiving & Dec 25. Advance online purchase saves $2/ticket ($28 online vs $30 at desk). Friday UNIQLO evening hours are free ONLY for NYC residents (not visitors). Pairs directly with The Modern ★★ next door.
items.maxTransitFromShortlist: 14–27 min from all shortlisted hotels (walkable from citizenM)

items.name: American Museum of Natural History
items.neighborhood: Upper West Side (200 Central Park West)
items.exceptions: Closed Thanksgiving & Dec 25. Timed-entry reservation required even for passholders; ticketed exhibitions/planetarium extra ($39/adult for General + 1 Special Exhibition).
items.coupleCost: $74 non-resident General Admission ($37 × 2; $60 online regional/resident varies — confirm state on checkout)
flags: Verify online vs walk-up non-resident general admission tier ($30–$37/adult depending on residency & exhibition add-on)

items.name: Whitney Museum of American Art
items.neighborhood: Meatpacking District (99 Gansevoort St — Southern High Line Terminus)
items.hours: Mon, Wed, Thu, Sat, Sun 10:30–18:00; Fri 10:30–22:00; Closed Tuesday
items.exceptions: FREE FOR EVERYONE every Friday night 17:00–22:00 and on the Second Sunday of every month (Sun Feb 14 is pre-window; Sun Mar 14, 2027 falls inside window!). Advance free ticket recommended.
items.coupleCost: $60 regular ($30 × 2) or $0 Free Friday Night (17:00–22:00) / Second Sunday (Mar 14, 2027)
items.maxTransitFromShortlist: 12–22 min via A/C/E or L (walkable via High Line from Chelsea)

items.name: Solomon R. Guggenheim Museum
items.neighborhood: Upper East Side (1071 Fifth Ave at 89th St)
items.exceptions: Pay-What-You-Wish (minimum $1/person) Tuesdays & Sundays 16:00–17:30 (last ticket 17:00). Pairs with a walk from The Met along Museum Mile.

items.name: 9/11 Memorial & Museum
items.neighborhood: Lower Manhattan / World Trade Center (180 Greenwich St)
items.daysOpen: Memorial: Daily · Museum: Wed–Mon (Closed non-holiday Tue)
items.hours: Outdoor Memorial: Daily 08:00–20:00 · Museum: Wed–Mon 09:00–19:00 (last entry 17:30); Closed non-holiday Tuesdays
items.exceptions: Free Admission Mondays at the Museum 17:30–19:00: free tickets released each Monday at 07:00 ET on 911memorial.org. Note whether Tue Feb 16, 2027 (Presidents' Week) opens as a holiday exception.
items.coupleCost: $0 Outdoor Memorial · $72 Museum ($36 × 2; or $0 Free Monday 17:30–19:00)
items.maxTransitFromShortlist: 8–24 min (walkable from Frederick Tribeca, Eurostars Wall St & Beekman)

items.name: Statue of Liberty & Ellis Island (Statue City Cruises)
items.hours: First ferry 09:00; last departure from Battery Park 15:30; last return from Liberty Island 17:00 (Winter schedule)
items.exceptions: Statue City Cruises is the ONLY authorized National Park Service concessioner — avoid street ticket resellers. Pedestal & Crown ($25.80/pp) require early advance reservation (up to 1 entry per 6 months for Crown). Afternoon departures after 14:00 may only reach 1 island.
items.coupleCost: $51.60 General Ferry + Grounds/Ellis ($25.80 × 2) · $51.60 Crown Reserve ($25.80 × 2, limited)
items.maxTransitFromShortlist: 10–26 min via 1 or 4/5 to Bowling Green / South Ferry

items.name: Staten Island Ferry (Free Harbor Skyline & Liberty Views)
items.neighborhood: Whitehall Terminal, Lower Manhattan (4 Whitehall St)
items.hours: 24 hours daily — every 30 min off-peak & weekends; every 15–20 min weekday rush hours
items.exceptions: 100% FREE — NYC DOT warns never to pay third-party 'Staten Island Ferry ticket' sellers. Passengers must disembark at St. George Terminal and re-board for the return trip (~25 min each way).
items.maxTransitFromShortlist: 10–26 min via 1, R/W, or 4/5 (walkable from Eurostars Wall St)

items.name: Empire State Building (86th Floor Observatory)
items.hours: Typically 09:00–22:00 / 23:00 in Feb–Mar (varies by date on official calendar; last elevator 45 min before close)
items.exceptions: 102nd Floor add-on and sunset prime windows cost extra; all tickets non-refundable. Walkable (<8 min) from DoubleTree Chelsea, Arlo NoMad, Evelyn & Fifth Ave Hotel.
items.coupleCost: From $88–$97+ ($44 base + booking fee × 2; sunset/102nd Fl extra)

items.name: 29th Chinatown Lunar New Year Parade & Festival (Year of the Goat/Sheep)

items.name: Bank of America Winter Village at Bryant Park (Ice Rink)
items.neighborhood: Midtown (40th–42nd St & Sixth Ave — across from Gabriel Kreuther ★★)
items.hours: Daily 08:00–22:00 (select Fri/Sat & holiday nights until midnight)
items.exceptions: SEASONAL CUTOFF: Holiday shops close early Jan; Rink & The Lodge stay open only through late Feb / Mar 1, 2027 — unavailable for mid-March trips! Free ice admission if bringing own skates; skate rentals $19–$60/pp.
items.coupleCost: $0 skating with own skates · $38–$120 with skate rentals ($19–$60 × 2)

items.name: The High Line Elevated Park
items.neighborhood: Hudson Yards (34th St) to Meatpacking (Gansevoort St)
items.exceptions: Sections can close temporarily during snow or ice events in Feb/Mar. Directly connects Chelsea hotels (24th–29th St) to the Whitney Museum & Semma.
items.maxTransitFromShortlist: 5–22 min (immediate walk from DoubleTree Chelsea & Hyatt Place Chelsea)

items.name: Brooklyn Bridge Pedestrian Promenade & DUMBO Waterfront
items.neighborhood: City Hall / Centre St (Manhattan) to DUMBO (Brooklyn)
items.hours: Open 24 hours daily (sunrise or golden hour recommended)
items.exceptions: Bikes now use a dedicated roadway lane — pedestrian boardwalk is vendor-free and cyclist-free. Dress in windproof layers for East River crossings in Feb/Mar.
items.maxTransitFromShortlist: 5–22 min via 4/5/6, J/Z, R/W, or A/C (walkable from Beekman, Eurostars & Frederick)

items.name: New York Public Library — Stephen A. Schwarzman Building & Polonsky Exhibition
items.neighborhood: Midtown / Fifth Ave & 42nd St (Adjacent to Bryant Park & Gabriel Kreuther ★★)
